purpose: Diagnose which declared model dimensions accompany regime transitions, decompose starting-position and pollinator-community contributions to response geometry, and quantify directional asymmetry in local-filtering branch reallocation without reopening or retuning the frozen Chapter 2 design.

regime_boundary_drivers.response: negative_trait_grid_fraction at each of the 48 fixed joint-design points
regime_boundary_drivers.parameter_scaling: centre each parameter at its declared range midpoint and divide by its full declared range
regime_boundary_drivers.multivariate_model: ordinary least squares with intercept and all 10 additive parameter terms; no interactions and no parameter selection
reported_quantities: coefficient signed over the full declared parameter range
regime_boundary_drivers.boundary_direction_check: For all-positive to mixed and mixed to all-negative contrasts, report the difference in mean range-scaled parameter value and Cliff's delta for every parameter.
regime_boundary_drivers.claim_rule: Call these multivariate design-space associations or boundary diagnostics, never causal effects or natural drivers. Do not remove parameters, add interactions, tune regularization, densify the surface or search new seeds after seeing results.

starting_position_by_community_realizati.baseline_matrix: 21 starting positions by 96 matched pollinator-community realizations
starting_position_by_community_realizati.joint_matrices: one 21 by 24 matrix for each of the 48 fixed joint-design points
starting_position_by_community_realizati.decomposition: two-way additive sum-of-squares partition into starting-position main effect, community-realization main effect and non-additive starting-position-by-community remainder; one value per cell means the remainder is not separated from simulation noise
starting_position_by_community_realizati.additional_summary: fraction of observed cell signs that differ from the sign of the fitted additive value
starting_position_by_community_realizati.claim_rule: Report variance shares as deterministic properties of the fixed synthetic ensemble. The non-additive remainder is evidence of state-by-realization contingency in the model, not an empirical interaction estimate.

local_filtering_directionality.baseline: zero-filtering reproduction-response sign for each of the 864 fixed lineage contrasts
reported_quantities: baseline negative, zero and positive denominators
complete baseline-sign to current-sign transition table at each frozen filtering strength
first sign-change threshold distribution by baseline sign
local_filtering_directionality.claim_rule: Treat the 864 contrasts as the complete synthetic design enumeration, not independent biological replicates. Report no inferential p-values or ecological-frequency interpretation. If the directional rate difference changes sign across strengths, describe directionality as strength-dependent rather than selecting one strength.

fail_closed_checks: recomputed baseline class counts must equal 41 mixed, 42 all-positive and 13 all-negative among 96 realizations
recomputed joint class counts must equal 16 mixed, 22 all-positive and 10 all-negative among 48 points
recomputed local-filtering counts and first-threshold summary must equal the frozen Phase 3 artifact
input hashes must match before execution
any mismatch stops result freezing and manuscript promotion
prohibited_interpretations: design-point frequencies as natural ecological prevalence
synthetic parameter associations as field-estimated causal effects
ultimate explanations for why island biotas, starting states or local communities formed
